What Are Nicotine Salts?

Nicotine salts, often referred to as nic salts, are a type of e-liquid formulation designed to mimic the natural state of nicotine found in tobacco leaves. Unlike freebase nicotine, which is the form traditionally used in most e-liquids, nicotine salts use an added compound (commonly benzoic acid) to lower the pH level. This makes the vapor smoother and allows for higher nicotine concentrations without the harshness typically associated with stronger freebase e-liquids.

This innovation changed vaping completely. It allowed users to achieve the same level of nicotine satisfaction they would get from a cigarette—but with less vapor, smoother hits, and a cleaner taste. For smokers trying to transition away from cigarettes, nicotine salts became a revelation.

Why Nicotine Salts Are So Popular in Kenya

The Kenyan vaping community has grown steadily, with more users seeking alternatives to traditional smoking. However, one of the biggest challenges new vapers face is finding an experience that replicates the satisfaction of a real cigarette. This is where nicotine salt e-liquids come in.

Nicotine salts deliver nicotine more efficiently into the bloodstream, providing quicker satisfaction. The result? Fewer cravings, smoother inhalation, and an experience that feels remarkably similar to smoking—without the tar, ash, or lingering odor.

Another reason for their growing popularity in Kenya is the flavor variety. From classic tobacco and menthol to exotic fruit and dessert blends, nic salts cater to every preference. Before deciding on which of these device types is right for you, it’s a good idea to take a closer look at their key features and how they work.

Just as their name suggests, disposable vapes are single-use products, meaning they should be disposed of after use. They come pre-filled with nic salt e-liquid and are ready-charged making them ideal for beginners or vapers who prioritise ease of use. The functionality of disposables is straightforward—simply inhale from the mouthpiece to activate the device, and you're ready to vape.

Disposables are compact and lightweight, often resembling traditional cigarettes, making them portable and discreet. However, due to their prefilled nature, they may not be the best option for those wanting a customisable experience. Many disposable vapes are only available with a 20mg (2%) nicotine content, which may be too strong for some users. And while some disposables are available in a 10mg option, they aren’t always easy to find.

Prefilled vapes, such as prefilled pod kits, on the other hand, offer a balance between convenience and versatility. These vape devices consist of a rechargeable battery component and prefilled pods containing e-liquid. Unlike disposables, prefilled vapes can be used multiple times by simply replacing the pod or cartridge when it runs out of e-liquid and recharging the battery.

Although prefilled vapes can be reused again and again, you’re still somewhat limited when it comes to nicotine strengths and flavours, as you can only pair the device with compatible prefilled pods.

If you’re looking for ultimate freedom, refillable vapes are the surefire winner. Not only are these devices rechargeable, but they feature an empty pod that can be topped up with just about any e-liquid you like. This means that you’re free to choose from literally hundreds of different brands, flavours, formulas and nicotine strengths. Plus, refillable vapes can range from simplistic, pen-style devices to sophisticated models with additional features such as airflow control and adjustable wattage.

Before making your decision on which vape device suits you best, it’s crucial to factor in how much each option will cost you, both in the long term as well as the short term.

Disposables typically have the lowest initial cost, making them an attractive option for budget-conscious users. You can usually get your hands on a disposable vape for £5-£6 depending on where you shop, which is also why they’re a great option for those in need of an emergency backup device while on the go.

However, since disposables are designed for single use and need to be replaced entirely once depleted, they can become more expensive over time due to frequent repurchasing. If you’re spending 1500? a day on disposable vapes, this can quickly add up and become the least affordable option in the long run.

Much like disposables, prefilled vapes are also available for a fairly low upfront cost. In fact, you can get your hands on many of the most popular prefilled vapes for under 1500?, meaning they cost about the same amount as two disposable vapes. But of course, you’ll need to factor in the fact that you’ll need to replace your prefilled pods when they are empty. While replacement pods are generally cheaper than purchasing new disposable devices, the ongoing cost of buying pods can also add up over time depending on how often you vape.

Refillable vapes are by far the most affordable option for long-term vaping. While the initial investment can cost more than disposables and prefilled kits, they quickly become the most cost-effective option in the long run. Once you’ve bought the device, which can cost anywhere from 1500? to 7000? depending on which brand and advanced features you want, you’ll only need to cover the ongoing costs of eliquid and replacement pods or coils, which can be more affordable than continuously buying disposables or prefilled pods.

Ultimately, the best vape option for you depends on your preferences, lifestyle, and goals. Whether you prioritize simplicity, versatility, or affordability, there's a device out there to suit your needs.
